connector.name: Telegraph
connector.registryDescription: Decentralized AI inference (weather, deepfake detection, LLMs) with x402 USDC micropayments.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package telegraph-protocol-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the telegraphprotocol account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: TELEGRAPH_NODE_URL
env.description: Telegraph node public API URL (e.g. http://13.237.89.59:7044)

env.name: TELEGRAPH_ENGINE_URL
env.description: Telegraph Engine inference server URL (e.g. http://13.237.89.59:8080)

env.name: TELEGRAPH_DAEMON_URL
env.description: Telegraph Daemon signal API URL (e.g. http://13.237.89.59:8081)

env.name: TELEGRAPH_EVM_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: EVM private key (0x-prefixed hex) of a USDC-funded burner wallet used to sign x402 payments. At least one of TELEGRAPH_EVM_PRIVATE_KEY or TELEGRAPH_SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY is required.

env.name: TELEGRAPH_SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Solana private key (base58) for SVM x402 payments. Optional alternative to TELEGRAPH_EVM_PRIVATE_KEY.

env.name: EVM_NETWORK
env.description: CAIP-2 network identifier for EVM payments. Defaults to eip155:*.

env.name: SVM_NETWORK
env.description: CAIP-2 network identifier for Solana payments. Defaults to solana:*.

env.name: REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS
env.description: Dynamic miner-tool refresh interval in milliseconds. Defaults to 300000 (5 min). Set to 0 to disable.
